summary: This Form 8-K reports that Bain Capital Private Credit's wholly owned subsidiary, BCPC I, LLC, entered into a New Commitment Request under its existing Revolving Credit Facility. The accordion feature increased lender commitments from $200 million to $250 million, with Goldman Sachs Bank USA serving as administrative agent and lender. The filing pertains to a routine credit facility amendment, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or restructuring. It is a standard current report on entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation, which falls outside the defined special-situations categories.
